title: Monolithic magnetic apparatus and process for making said monolithic magnetic apparatus

features.item: A housing containing a displaceable magnet and pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.
features.quote: The present invention concerns a magnetic apparatus for magnetic clamping of ferrous elements (P 1 ), comprising a support structure ( 11 ) with at least one pole piece ( 30 A) held within its thickness (S)
features.note: The reference describes a support structure (housing) containing pole pieces for magnetic clamping.
features.refuted: Quote describes a pole piece held within support structure thickness, not a housing containing a displaceable magnet and pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: A magnet displaceable along a direction between a gripping position and a release position.
features.note: The reference describes a magnetic apparatus with a magnetic core and electric coil for changing magnetization state, but does not explicitly mention a displaceable magnet or distinct gripping/release positions.

features.item: Pole shoes attached to the housing, each with a workpiece contact surface.
features.quote: comprising a support structure ( 11 ) with at least one pole piece ( 30 A) held within its thickness (S), first and second sides ( 12, 13 ) being formed in said support structure
features.note: The pole piece is part of the support structure, and the first side of the support structure acts as a continuous ferromagnetic surface for clamping, which implies a workpiece contact surface.
features.refuted: Quote describes pole piece held within support structure with first and second sides, but does not teach pole shoes attached to housing with workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: Pole shoes designed to guide a magnetic field portion to the workpiece contact surface.
features.quote: said at least one first pole piece collector ( 50 ) being adapted to convey at least one first magnetic flux (F 1 ) generated by said magnetic apparatus to said first side ( 12, 13 ).
features.note: The pole piece collector is explicitly stated to convey magnetic flux to the first side, which serves as the workpiece contact surface.
features.refuted: Quote describes a pole piece collector conveying magnetic flux to a side, not pole shoes guiding magnetic field to a workpiece contact surface.

features.item: A workpiece contact surface defining a contact surface angle of 170° to 190° with the displacement direction.
features.note: The reference does not describe any specific angles for the workpiece contact surface relative to a displacement direction, as a displaceable magnet is not disclosed.

features.item: A magnetic gripper with housing, displaceable magnet, and pole shoes where contact surface angle is 170° to 190° relative to displacement direction.
features.note: The reference does not disclose a displaceable magnet or specific contact surface angles.

features.item: A magnetic gripper system with a magnetic gripper and ferromagnetic workpiece, where magnet in gripping position presses workpiece against contact surfaces by magnetic force.
features.quote: A magnetic apparatus for magnetic clamping of ferrous elements, comprising: a support structure formed of ferromagnetic material
features.note: The apparatus is designed for magnetic clamping of ferrous elements, implying the workpiece is pressed against contact surfaces by magnetic force.
features.refuted: Quote only describes a magnetic apparatus with ferromagnetic support structure, not a complete gripper system with magnet in gripping position pressing workpiece against contact surfaces.

features.item: Housing extending along a longitudinal axis with displacement direction parallel to that axis.
features.note: The reference mentions width, length, and thickness for the support structure but does not describe a longitudinal axis or a displacement direction parallel to it.

features.item: Pole shoes with an active structure for directing the magnetic field portion.
features.quote: said at least one first pole piece collector being adapted to convey at least one first magnetic flux generated by said magnetic apparatus to said first side
features.note: The pole piece collector acts as an active structure to convey the magnetic flux to the clamping surface.
features.refuted: Quote describes pole piece collector conveying flux to a side, but does not teach pole shoes with an active structure for directing magnetic field.

features.item: An active structure with a bevel defining a bevel angle of 5° to 85° with the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe any bevels or specific angles on the pole pieces or active structures.

features.item: An active structure with multiple projections for directing magnetic field and forming the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference describes a continuous ferromagnetic surface on the first side, not multiple projections.

features.item: Adjacent first and second projections with a recess between them, recess depth or length deviating by at most 25% from projection length.
features.note: The reference does not describe multiple projections or recesses between them on the workpiece contact surface.

features.item: A positioning device on the magnetic gripper for positioning the ferromagnetic workpiece on the contact surface.
features.note: The reference describes a magnetic apparatus for clamping but does not mention any specific positioning device for the workpiece.

features.item: First and second pole shoes where the magnet in gripping position makes the first pole shoe act as north pole and second as south pole.
features.quote: said at least one first pole piece collector being adapted to convey at least one first magnetic flux generated by said magnetic apparatus to said first side
features.note: The reference describes a first pole piece collector conveying magnetic flux to a first side, and later mentions a second pole piece collector conveying flux to a second side, implying a bipolar arrangement. However, it does not explicitly state that one acts as a north pole and the other as a south pole, nor does it refer to a 'gripping position' for a displaceable magnet.

features.item: A magnet displaceable electrically, pneumatically, or mechanically between gripping and release positions.
features.note: The reference describes an electric coil for changing the magnetization state of a magnetic core, but not a physically displaceable magnet.

features.item: A position sensor detecting gripping position and/or release position, or a workpiece sensor detecting the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.note: The reference does not mention any sensors for detecting position or workpiece presence.

features.item: Housing with a receptacle for receiving a workpiece sensor and/or a supply line.
features.note: The reference does not describe any receptacles for sensors or supply lines.

features.item: A manipulator interface on the magnetic gripper for attaching to a manipulator.
features.note: The reference describes a magnetic apparatus but does not mention any interface for attaching it to a manipulator.

features.item: Housing portion designed to suppress magnetic field escape, or a shielding device to at least partially prevent magnetic field escape.
features.note: The reference does not discuss suppressing magnetic field escape or shielding devices.

features.item: At least one projection with length deviating by at most 25% from the thickness of the ferromagnetic workpiece.
features.note: The reference does not describe projections on the workpiece contact surface or their dimensions relative to workpiece thickness.

features.item: A receptacle in the form of a groove in the housing.
features.note: The reference describes recesses for accommodating magnetic components but not a groove in the housing for other purposes like sensors or supply lines.

features.item: A bevel angle of 15° to 75° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe any bevels or specific angles on the active structure.

features.item: A bevel angle of 40° to 60° between the active structure bevel and the workpiece contact surface.
features.note: The reference does not describe any bevels or specific angles on the active structure.
